messages:
Diane: quick check — onboarding aurora-96b variant for long-context tests. Are weights live in S3 and do we have the tokenizer patch landed? Also need a sanity pass on max context / kv-cache sizing before we flip to dedicated pools.
Matteo: weights uploaded to staging yesterday, havent run mem smoke yet. @cheng can you confirm checksum?
Sarah: tokenizer PR #482 merged. note: special token handling for >65k vocab was reverted then re-applied, so older containers might map pad/sep weirdly.
Cheng: Confirmed weights at s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-96b/v1/weights/sha256:0a1b2c3d — md5 9b8c7d6e. KV cache format = arkv2 (sharded). We should validate shard count before runtime gyro.
Liam: quick smoke config suggestion — run on 8xA100-80GB with these overrides:
```
model:
  name: aurora-96b
  max_context: 196608  # 192k tokens
  kv_cache_format: arkv2
  kv_shards: 8
  kv_dtype: int8
serve:
  batch_size: 4
  max_workers: 2
```
Matteo: ok need mem estimate — expected peak per GPU? ballpark helps 80 vs 40GB decision.
Diane: rough from similar 70-80B: weights ~36GB, kv ~up to 40GB at 192k if dense per-shard; with arkv2 + int8 expect ~18-22GB kv per GPU + 4-6GB activations. 80GB looks safe but enable OOM guard.
ops-bot: scheduled run: ci-aurora-smoke @ 2024-11-05T14:30Z (job id ci-99321). Resources reserved: 8xA100-80GB for 60m.
Sarah: tokenizer edge-case: HF tokenizer sometimes yields token id 65534 on some builds — I'll push a small validator to assert ids < 65535 and map any unexpected ids.
Cheng: running md5 + kv-format validator now.
Cheng: md5 matches. kv-format validator:
```
format: arkv2
shards: 8
shard_sizes: [460000000, 458900000, 459100000, 460200000, 459800000, 458700000, 459900000, 459600000]
header_ok: true
```
Cheng: small note — shard 5 had an extra legacy header byte; I'll strip it before serving to avoid parse fallback.
Matteo: I'll run smoke once strip applied. @Diane drop exact s3 path in CI config and pin tokenizer wheel in container.
Diane: CI updated:
model_weights: s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-96b/v1/weights/sha256:0a1b2c3d
tokenizer_wheel: s3://redwood-artifacts/tokenizers/aurora-tokenizer-1.2.0-py3-none.whl
Diane: added startup flag --oom-guard=true and fallback model aurora-70b in rollout policy.
Matteo: ack — running in ~10m, will paste logs. ping me for triage.
Sarah: running tokenizer validator now; will post results here.
Matteo: logs: initial load ok, kv shards loaded, warning about shard 5 header fixed by strip, memory high but stable, first longctx inference succeeded. sample perf: 0.12s/token end-to-end with batching=4.
Diane: awesome, thanks. Next: finalize dedicated pool sizing + cost estimate. I'll open follow-up ticket to track.
Liam: :thumbsup: call out if you want extra safety margin for prod.
Matteo: marking onboarding smoke done; will follow up in ticket with perf + cost numbers.
